text: Swimming is a wonderful way to stay active and healthy. It is important to know the proper technique for swimming, and that means kicking first and breathing later. Kicking is a crucial element of swimming, as it helps propel the swimmer through the water. The best way to kick is to start with the legs, lifting them up and down in a flutter kick motion. Breathing comes later in the swimming process, as it is more important to focus on the kick and staying afloat before worrying about the surface of the water.
